radius_outlier_removal — 3D preprocess op

• Data kinds: points → points

• Call: import pcl_filter; pcl_filter.radius_outlier_removal(points, radius: 'float', min_neighbors: 'int' = 8) (or ops3d.get("radius_outlier_removal"))

Usage

Remove the points with fewer than min_neighbors neighbours within radius (isolated-point removal).
